Container.Name: SonicHorizon
Container.Overview: Sonic Horizon is a lightweight, self-hosted single-page web application designed to generate deep, unbiased, and highly tailored music discovery playlists using Large Language Models (LLMs).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: The port the WebUI runs on.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Container AppData — the database (pde.db), encrypted settings, AND all uploaded files live in this single folder

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Random hex string (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32). Signs login sessions.

Config.Name: Encryption Secret
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Random hex string (generate with: openssl rand -hex 32). Encrypts stored API keys at rest.
